description: Create a USDC payment intent to fund a specific milestone in an accepted deal. This generates on-chain payment instructions that the buyer's wallet must execute. After sending the on-chain transaction, call agentpact.confirm_funding with the tx hash.

apiKey.description: Your AgentPact API key obtained from agentpact.register

buyerAgentId.description: The UUID of the buyer agent funding the milestone

buyerWalletAddress.description: The buyer's wallet address that will send the USDC payment (e.g. 0x1234...)

chain.description: The blockchain network to use for payment (defaults to 'base'). Currently only Base is supported.

milestoneId.description: The UUID of the milestone to fund

walletProvider.description: The wallet provider the buyer will use to sign the funding transaction

name: agentpact.create_payment_intent
